<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

LMCache generates KV events when it stores KV Cache to CPU, disk and other storage. This commit enables SGLang to retrieve the events from LMCache when it is processing a request.

KV Events help KV-cache-aware routing make more efficient decisions, based on not only KV caches in GPU, but also KV caches in CPU, disk and other medium.


## Modifications

Implement `take_events()` for the LMCache connector.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

## Benchmarking and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the PR flow. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`, `/tag-and-rerun-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls to merge.

## Notes to reviewers:

You can test this functionality as follows:

1. Use the latest version of LMCache which has https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache/pull/2441 merged or build LMCache with the LMCache branch
2. Follow steps in `python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/storage/lmcache/README.md` in this PR to setup event generation and publishing
3. Use a client to process the events generated by SGLang

inline_comments.body:
![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The current implementation of `take_events` in `LMCRadixCache` overrides the parent `RadixCache.take_events` method but does not call it. This means that any KV cache events generated by the `RadixCache` itself (e.g., from insertions or evictions) and stored in `self.kv_event_queue` will be lost. The method should combine events from both the `lmcache_connector` and the base `RadixCache`.

The proposed suggestion also simplifies the conditional logic for better readability.

```python
    def take_events(self):
        """Retrieve KV events from LMCache and RadixCache.

        Returns:
            A list of KV cache events.
        """
        lmcache_blocks = []
        if hasattr(self.lmcache_connector, "get_kv_events"):
            events = self.lmcache_connector.get_kv_events()
            if events:
                lmcache_blocks = [
                    BlockStored(
                        block_hashes=e.block_hashes,
                        parent_block_hash=e.parent_block_hash,
                        token_ids=e.token_ids,
                        lora_id=e.lora_id,
                        block_size=e.block_size,
                    )
                    for e in events
                ]
        else:
            warn_kv_events_once()

        radix_events = super().take_events()
        return radix_events + lmcache_blocks
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The JSON string for `--kv-events-config` seems to contain an invalid field. The `KVEventsConfig` model in `srt/disaggregation/kv_events.py` does not have an `enable_kv_cache_events` field, and pydantic will likely raise a validation error for this extra field. This field should probably be removed from the example.

Also, if it were a valid boolean field, the value should be the JSON boolean `true` instead of the string `"True"`.

```suggestion
  --kv-events-config '{"publisher": "zmq", "topic": "kv-events"}'
```

reviews.body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces the capability to retrieve KV cache events from LMCache by implementing the `take_events` method in `LMCRadixCache`. The changes are well-structured and include corresponding updates to the documentation and example configuration.

My review has identified a couple of areas for improvement:
- A potential bug in `lmc_radix_cache.py` where the new `take_events` method does not include events from the parent `RadixCache`, potentially leading to lost events. I've provided a suggestion to combine events from both sources.
- An issue in the `README.md` where the example command for `--kv-events-config` contains a field that is not defined in the configuration model, which would likely cause a runtime error. A correction has been suggested.

With these fixes, the pull request should be in good shape. The new feature is a valuable addition for enabling more advanced cache-aware routing.
